[LCSP.6.2] **Lazy pool init.** When the artefact has
`constspace: true`, the loader arms the pooled strategy. The
integrator's pool-sizing call supplies the capacities and
initialises the pools (slab pools, pre-sized arenas), identical to the
`realtime` allocator path. The sizing call supplies capacities only; it
never selects the strategy ([NLFC.10.3]).
